title: K2 Horizon: A connected fleet of six open models
summary: K2 Horizon is Kyutai's release of six interconnected open-source AI models designed to work as a coordinated 'fleet' rather than isolated systems, enabling collaborative AI capabilities through shared architectures and communication protocols.
problem_solved: Addresses the limitation of standalone AI models by creating a connected ecosystem where specialized models can collaborate efficiently.
why_valuable: Provides transparency and flexibility of open-source models with the coordinated intelligence of a unified system, democratizing access to advanced AI infrastructure.
